evidence.observations: Chromium reproduces the exact startup interleaving by delaying delivery of optionalModules.js while forwarding the original bootstrap timer unchanged. The timer runs at document.readyState interactive with both loader and error reporter undefined. After dependencies finish and the loading screen disappears, the bootstrap flag is still true, identity is still absent and no retry has loaded it. The real Start a Showdown button navigates to createShowdown without any sign-in overlay or SIGN IN WITH GOOGLE button; page errors remain empty. This confirms the finding independently of the previously recorded emulator journey failures.
evidence.scope: Isolated local Chromium browser serving unchanged detached main. The test delays one later deferred script response without changing its bytes and records the original timer before forwarding it. No sign-in, live provider, account or gameplay write is attempted. This check proves startup/navigation behavior, not the rest of the full journey.
